title: Non-IID (Dirichlet alpha) sensitivity and scalability of bsc_7
reference: saved grouped partition (alpha 0.5, 8 clients): Phase 2d/2e and the comparison table
partition: runtime Dirichlet repartition with partition seed 42 for MediShield and FedAvg alike (train_defended.py --partition-seed 42)
procedure_per_setting: 1 calibrate: trains its own known-clean controls (seeds 42, 44, 45) on that partition
2 one shadow (no filtering) attacked run on development seed 46
3 recalibrate with the controls and the shadow capture (records the development attack)
4 live development gate on seed 46 (unchanged criteria); filtering on evaluation seeds only if it passes
5 MediShield clean + attacked on seeds 90-92 (--live-gate-dir), FedAvg clean + attacked on the same partition and seeds
attack: Phase 2d attack (2 attackers at 8 clients, 4 at 16 clients via malicious ratio 0.25; poison 0.5; constant trigger columns 5-8 value 5; target Benign)
reported: per seed: final ASR MediShield vs FedAvg, detection, honest FPR (attacked and clean runs), clean and attacked F1 vs FedAvg, held rounds, stops
status: Descriptive sensitivity study (3 evaluation seeds per setting); detector configuration unchanged.
